name: Camino del Norte (Cantabria)
description_md:
The Camino del Norte in Cantabria is a waymarked hiking route covering 185.2 km. It involves 3303 m of ascent and 3350 m of descent.

The route is signposted as CdN and forms part of the national waymarked hiking network in Spain. The walking time takes about 55 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule, and the difficulty is hard, derived from distance and ascent. Nearby places include Santander and the Hospital of San Rafael within 200 m, and Playa de La Concha within 1800 m.
